sourceWorkflow.focused:
focused:
    # Keep the existing required status: no individual shard can qualify the gate.
    if: >-
      always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
      needs.preflight.result == 'success' &&
      needs.preflight.outputs.admission != 'hold' &&
      needs.preflight.outputs.focusedRequired == 'true'
    needs: [preflight, focused_shards]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    env:
      EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      EXPECTED_AUTOMATION: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Require every shard job to succeed
        env:
          SHARDS_RESULT: ${{ needs.focused_shards.result }}
        run: test "$SHARDS_RESULT" = success

      - name: Check out trusted focused receipt verifier
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09 # v5
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          path: automation
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            publishing/focused-test-map.json
            publishing/focused-tests.mjs
            publishing/test-policy.json
            publishing/test-policy.mjs
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@a0853c24544627f65ddf259abe73b1d18a591444 # v5
        with:
          package-manager-cache: false
          node-version: 20.19.x

      - name: Download immutable preflight admission
        uses: actions/download-artifact@37930b1c2abaa49bbe596cd826c3c89aef350131 # v7
        with:
          name: admission-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/preflight-admission

      - name: Download all four focused shard receipts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@37930b1c2abaa49bbe596cd826c3c89aef350131 # v7
        with:
          pattern: focused-shard-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-*
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/focused-shards
          merge-multiple: false

      - name: Require exact complete command coverage
        run: |
          node automation/publishing/focused-tests.mjs \
            --verify-shards "$RUNNER_TEMP/focused-shards" \
            --artifact-prefix "focused-shard-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-" \
            --admission "$RUNNER_TEMP/preflight-admission/admission.json" \
            --manifest automation/publishing/focused-test-map.json \
            --test-policy automation/publishing/test-policy.json
sourceWorkflow.releaseReady:
release-ready:
    if: always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    needs: [preflight, focused, test, build]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Apply the selected PR gate policy
        env:
          ADMISSION: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.admission }}
          BUILD_RESULT: ${{ needs.build.result }}
          FOCUSED_RESULT: ${{ needs.focused.result }}
          FOCUSED_REQUIRED: ${{ needs.preflight.outputs.focusedRequired }}
          FULL_CI: ${{ vars.REVEALLINE_FULL_CI || 'false' }}
          PREFLIGHT_RESULT: ${{ needs.preflight.result }}
          TEST_RESULT: ${{ needs.test.result }}
        run: |
          test "$PREFLIGHT_RESULT" = success
          if [ "$ADMISSION" != hold ]; then
            if [ "$FOCUSED_REQUIRED" = true ]; then
              test "$FOCUSED_RESULT" = success
            else
              test "$FOCUSED_REQUIRED" = false
              test "$FOCUSED_RESULT" = skipped
            fi
          fi
          if [ "$ADMISSION" = maintenance ]; then
            echo 'Bounded documentation/controller maintenance: selected validation passed under the explicit test policy; waived suites are not passed. Product build not required.'
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ "$ADMISSION" = scheduled ]; then
            echo 'Explicit milestone schedule: selected validation passed under the explicit test policy; waived suites are not passed.'
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ "$ADMISSION" = release-evidence ]; then
            echo 'Docs-only post-merge release evidence: exact-source validation is required without allocating another product version.'
            test "$BUILD_RESULT" = success
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ "$ADMISSION" != release ]; then
            echo '::error::This product PR is not assigned an immutable release slot. Keep it draft/stacked, or promote one reviewed root by titling it Release vX.Y.Z.'
            exit 1
          fi
          test "$BUILD_RESULT" = success
          if [ "$FULL_CI" = true ]; then
            test "$TEST_RESULT" = success
          else
            echo "Full tests are deferred and do not block this PR."
          fi

fastlineWorkflow.content:
name: Fastline exact-head auto-merge

on:
  workflow_run:
    # Reconcile when any PR validation workflow completes, including a failure
    # that must disarm an earlier decision. The controller also waits for every
    # non-waived exact-head check already registered on the commit.
    workflows:
      - Validate source for continuous main
      - Appearance preview
      - Industrial feature verification
      - Company edition candidates
      - Assemble full-test release evidence
      - Community hosted acceptance
      - Community MinIO recovery
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types:
      [
        opened,
        reopened,
        synchronize,
        edited,
        labeled,
        unlabeled,
        milestoned,
        demilestoned,
        ready_for_review,
        converted_to_draft,
      ]
  pull_request_review:
    branches: [main]
    types: [submitted, dismissed]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  checks: read
  actions: write

concurrency:
  group: fastline-merge-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number || github.run_id }}
  # Metadata changes are cheap and read current state. Serializing them avoids
  # cancelled controller checks poisoning GitHub's merge-state rollup.
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  reconcile:
    # Completed failed/cancelled required gates must also wake the controller:
    # an exact head that was armed by an earlier successful run must be
    # disarmed when the required result changes.
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'workflow_run' ||
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # This privileged controller checks out automation only from protected main.
      # It never checks out or executes pull-request code.
      - name: Check out trusted controller
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09 # v5
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 1
          filter: blob:none
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            .github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml
            publishing/fastline-merge-controller.mjs
            publishing/admission-binding.mjs
            publishing/admission-preflight.mjs
            publishing/focused-tests.mjs
            publishing/focused-test-map.json
            publishing/test-policy.json
            publishing/test-policy.mjs
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false

      - name: Record one-time controller bootstrap
        if: hashFiles('publishing/fastline-merge-controller.mjs') == ''
        run: echo 'Trusted controller is not on protected main yet; this bootstrap event is intentionally a no-op.'

      - name: Reconcile exact-head admission
        if: hashFiles('publishing/fastline-merge-controller.mjs') != ''
        env:
          ACTIVE_MILESTONE: ${{ vars.REVEALLINE_ACTIVE_RELEASE }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node publishing/fastline-merge-controller.mjs
